about_the_game:
It has been two decades since the enemy first swept into the Solar System and attacked Earth. Humanity's forces put up a desperate fight for survival and, at great cost, slowed the enemy advance to a stalemate. Now, the heaviest fighting rages on continuously at the edges of the Solar System, far from the inner planets where a semblance of peace has returned.

It is against this backdrop that Earth intelligence discovered the locations of the enemy's homeworld and other planets within its wide-ranging domain. Hoping to force an enemy withdrawal and relieve pressure from Earth's defensive forces, the military formed a naval strike group to launch a surprise attack directly into their territory.

As captain of a Unified Earth Forces starship, you are thrust into the heart of the counter-offensive, leading daring missions deep into enemy territory. Your objective is to spearhead the assault, establish vital footholds, and pave the way for Marine landing forces.  Fly your ship to hostile planets, engage in thrilling ship-to-ship combat, and land on the surface to build fortified spaceports. Place a variety of emplacements to secure the area against waves of enemies. Of course, you can always use your trusty assault rifle in a pinch.

Build and Defend Planetary Fortifications

Think strategically as you deploy barriers, turrets, gates, and barbed wire on the planet to safeguard the area against relentless waves of enemies.  Or, if it's been a long day, maybe you can just build a wall of turrets.  The enemy will get the message.  Create a secure zone to allow our Marines to land safely.  After reinforcements arrive and you've succeeded in your mission, you can get resupplied with unlimited materials to continue building in a sandbox mode.  Keep coming back to the planet to work on the base and fight off enemies!

Experience Intense Space Battles

Test your skills as a starship captain as you evade hostile fire, strafe alien space stations, and escort ships during fleet battles.  Blast incoming missiles with your ship's point-defense turret and strike hard with your railguns.  Dominate the fight and secure victory.

Relax and Enjoy Down Time

Fortified Space offers more than just adrenaline-pumping combat.  Take a break from the battlefield to walk around your ship, talk to your crew, and read the news articles that update after each mission.  Gather materials through asteroid mining, hydroponic farming, and composting.  You can even kick around a soccer ball or play a target-shooting arcade game.  

Ready for shore leave?  Fly to Earth and explore the civic and cultural institutions in humanity's capital.  Don't forget to visit the Library of Earth to read about the Interplanetary War and other interesting topics.

Demo Version

This demo comes with early-game planets and a brief taste of space combat to whet your appetite. Many of the features of the full game are available, but the demo only includes the very beginnings of the campaign. That being said, there is no overall time limit for gameplay, and the plan is to keep this demo active indefinitely for you to enjoy.  The demo lets you:

  • Fully explore and operate your ship. Fly it and fight with it.

  • Complete a full space-to-ground assault of an enemy planet. Forgrit, a desert planet that the enemy has used as a staging point for attacks on our Solar System, has been located. Warp to the planet, destroy any orbital defenses, and land on the surface to establish a fortified spaceport for our main landing force to use. Set up barriers and turrets, and expect heavy resistance.  After you complete the mission, sandbox mode is unlocked, which allows you to continue building with unlimited materials to your heart's content!

  • Join the start of a fleet battle. After the Battle of Forgrit, an enemy fleet was detected traveling to the planet to launch a counterattack. Join the Unified Earth Navy fleet and meet the enemy in open space. The demo limits this mission to 30 seconds.

  • Visit the capital city on Earth. Tour the major civic institutions of humanity. Make sure to spend some time in the Library of Earth, where you can read some of the lore!

In the full Early Access release, expect a full galaxy-spanning campaign and additional gameplay modes and features.  If you liked the demo, you'll love the full version.  Wishlist today!

Nightsail Game Studios

Special Thanks To:

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 4700U
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Fight back against humanity's enemies in this 2D retro-style space sim and tower defense game. Fly to alien planets, destroy their ships, and land to build fortified spaceports. Place defenses to create a secure zone, then hunker down as enemies attack. Join the fight as fleets clash in open space.
